text:
customer-sara: Hey team — we're seeing intermittent GitHub sign-ins fail with `state mismatch` when users come from certain links (shorteners / in-app webviews). ~15% of attempts yesterday.

support-jen: Sorry about that, can you share a raw redirect URL (no PII) and the state cookie value from an affected user?

customer-sara: Example redirect: `https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=abc123&state=Z9kKp%2B1xY9L...`
State cookie header observed: `session_state=Z9kKp%2B1xY9L...; Path=/; HttpOnly`
User agent: iOS WebView (Mobile Safari engine) inside our mobile app.

eng-ryan: Do you ever see duplicate `state` params or fragments (`#`)? Also any 302/307 hops before the callback? Could be linkshortener adding tracking params or rewriting.

mira: We had a similar flaky case — our CDN/edge was normalizing query params and dropping long values in some chains. Also some webviews limit cookie header lengths and drop cookie chunks.

customer-sara: Repro notes: if user signs in from our marketing short link (t.co -> redirect chain) it fails more often. If they open the same link in desktop it usually works.

sso-bot: LOG SNIPPET:
```
[2026-03-16T18:02:12Z] INFO callback GET /auth/callback?code=abc123&state=Z9kKp%2B1xY9L - cookie state: Z9kKp
session_store[state]=Z9kKp%2B1xY9L3fR...
server: state mismatch (stored vs. incoming)
user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_3 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Mobile/15E148
```

support-jen: Interesting — log shows the cookie was truncated (`Z9kKp` vs longer stored value). That smells like cookie chunking or header length limit.

eng-ryan: Quick mitigation idea: for affected user-agent patterns (iOS webview + redirect-chain), try server-side fallback: if cookie state missing or truncated but query `state` present and `code` present, attempt one-time exchange binding code->session after additional verification (IP UA match + short TTL). Low risk temporary fix.

mira: Medium-term: reduce client state length (still cryptographically safe) or store ephemeral state server-side keyed by a short token in the callback path (e.g., `/auth/callback/:otk`). That avoids cookie dependence.

customer-sara: I can collect a few failing redirect URLs and UA strings. Any specific headers to capture?

support-jen: Please capture full `Cookie` header from the browser, the full callback querystring, `Referer`, and any 3xx hops with response headers from the shortener. Also note whether the link was opened inside the app or external browser.

mira: @support-jen can you escalate this to eng-sso and attach 3 examples (redacted) + one failing session id? We'll need to reproduce in a webview emulator.

support-jen: Escalating now — adding eng-sso, attaching logs and 3 redacted URLs. @eng-ryan can you take ownership? :white_check_mark:

eng-ryan: Taking ownership. I'll open an internal ticket, add short-term fallback today, and follow up with a rollout plan for the client/state size change. Will post updates in this thread.

customer-sara: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
